text:
GENERATE BURST K1-warm — Run C-9 style gate, CHARACTER arm (WARM line). The REGISTER CARD above governs style. task_id "K1-warm".

Deliver SQUARE 1024x1024 character master frames: ONE full-body armoured knight, the knight in IMAGE 1, standing at rest.
IDENTITY (from IMAGE 1): full plate armour in blue-grey steel; a closed rounded helm with its visor down; a BLUE TABARD over the breastplate bearing gold heraldry (gold cross-crosslets and gold diagonal bands, as in IMAGE 1); a POLEAXE (long haft, axe blade with a hammer and top spike). CHANGE from IMAGE 1: NO pleated skirt below the tabard. The tabard ends at the hip and the thighs and legs show full plate armour, exactly as the knight in IMAGE 2 wears it (take only that garment cut from IMAGE 2, not its white tabard or its colours).
POSE AND CAMERA: a calm idle stance, weight on the back foot, the poleaxe held upright with its butt resting on the ground beside the front foot. He faces DOWN-RIGHT (toward the lower-right of the image, south-east). The view is a fixed game camera looking DOWN at about 53 degrees: the top of the helm and the tops of the shoulders are clearly visible, the torso is slightly shortened, the feet are seen from above. Orthographic: no perspective distortion. Full figure, feet at the bottom centre, the figure fills about 70 % of the frame height.
BACKGROUND: flat uniform pure #00ff00, nothing else: no ground, no shadow, no vignette, no border, no text.
REFERENCES: IMAGE 1 = the character (armour, heraldry, helm, poleaxe, proportions). IMAGE 2 = garment cut only (no skirt). IMAGE 3 shows the painted SURFACE of a manuscript (wash, pigment, vellum): match that surface quality in the rendering. Do not copy any reference's pose, fence, ground, background or flat perspective.
LINE ARM = WARM: a warm brown iron-gall ink line, never darker than a deep brown; softer and lighter than black ink; hatching in the same brown.

Make TWO image_gen calls, one per variant (a, b), with the same instructions (variants differ only by chance). ONE retry per variant only if a hard rule is visibly broken — name the reason. Copy the outputs from $CODEX_HOME/generated_images/... to out/K1-warm_a.png, out/K1-warm_b.png with sha256. No code. No other files. No web.
RETURN: receipt task_id "K1-warm"; images = the files with prompt, references (role + path) and elapsed_s; calls_used = the TRUE number of image_gen calls; status; concerns. Never PASS/FAIL.

references.role: IMAGE 1 — THE CHARACTER (identity, armour, heraldry, poleaxe)
IMAGE 2 — garment cut only: tabard to the hip, plate legs (no skirt)
IMAGE 3 — the painted surface of a manuscript; surface quality only
